### Summary

AMD now [publishes](https://rocm.docs.amd.com/projects/ai-ecosystem/en/latest/frameworks/pytorch/install.html?fam=all&os=linux&rocm-ver=10.0.0&pytorch-ver=2.13.0&i=pip&w=compute) official Torch wheels for Windows and Linux. As the upstream Torch repository is Linux-only, it would be helpful to fall back to the official AMD repository on Windows.

Notes:

- Supported GPUs are listed [here](https://github.com/ROCm/TheRock/blob/b927c1865f37fa7bbecf5c7e35dee41b02afbb4f/SUPPORTED_GPUS.md#rocm-on-windows)
- Both `torch` and `torchvision` need to have `[device-all]` appended to the package names
